ev.q: Call of Duty: Advanced Warfare is a 2014 first-person shooter game published by Activision
The game's story features a futuristic setting, set between 2054 and 2061
allows up to four players to engage in a wave-based match against A.I.-controlled enemies
allowing players to pick weapons, attachments, perks and score-streaks within a total of 13 allocation points
the player is given a certain number of upgrade points
unprecedented amount of fast movement, extensive multiplayer weapon customization, excellent visuals
coherent and fast-paced campaign, smart storytelling
